cases.task: In PocketFlow, Node(max_retries=0) and AsyncNode(max_retries=0) silently skip execution. Reject zero or negative max_retries at construction with a ValueError mentioning max_retries. Preserve behavior for positive values. Add a regression test in tests/test_max_retries_validation.py and run the repository tests.

In PocketFlow, synchronous BatchNode treats a None result from prep as an empty batch, but AsyncBatchNode and AsyncParallelBatchNode raise TypeError. Make both asynchronous batch node types return an empty list without calling exec_async when prep returns None. Preserve non-empty batch behavior. Add regression tests in tests/test_async_batch_node.py and run the repository tests.

In PocketFlow, Node and AsyncNode accept non-integer max_retries values and fail later during execution, while bool is silently treated as an integer. Reject bool and every non-integer max_retries at construction with TypeError mentioning max_retries. Keep positive integer retry counts valid. Add tests in tests/test_max_retries_type_validation.py and run the repository tests.

In PocketFlow, Node and AsyncNode accept invalid retry wait values that may fail only after execution starts or produce an invalid delay. At construction, require wait to be a finite non-negative int or float; reject bool and non-numbers with TypeError mentioning wait, and reject negative or non-finite numbers with ValueError mentioning wait. Preserve zero and positive finite values. Add tests in tests/test_wait_validation.py and run the repository tests.

In boltons.strutils, split_punct_ws and slugify split on ASCII punctuation and whitespace but leave Unicode punctuation attached to words. Treat Unicode punctuation (category P*) as a separator too, while preserving Unicode letters and the existing ASCII and whitespace behavior. Add regression tests to tests/test_strutils.py and run that test file.

In boltons.fileutils.iter_find_files, max_depth is documented as a traversal depth where 0 includes the starting directory. Reject negative max_depth values with ValueError mentioning max_depth instead of silently returning no matches. Preserve max_depth=None, zero, and positive behavior. Add tests to tests/test_fileutils.py and run that file.

In more_itertools.recipes.grouper, n=0 or a negative n silently returns an empty iterator. Reject every non-positive integer n with ValueError when grouper is called, for all incomplete modes (fill, ignore, strict). Preserve positive-size behavior and the existing invalid-mode error. Add regression tests to tests/test_recipes.py and run that test file.

In more_itertools.more, chunked(iterable, 0) and sliced(seq, 0) silently return empty iterators. Reject zero with ValueError when either function is called, in both strict and non-strict modes. Preserve positive sizes and chunked(iterable, None). Add regression tests to tests/test_more.py and run its ChunkedTests and SlicedTests; the full test_more.py contains an unrelated 100-thread test that exceeds the current sandbox process limit.

In more_itertools.more, split_at, split_before, split_after, and split_when document maxsplit=-1 as the unlimited sentinel and non-negative values as bounded split counts. Reject maxsplit values below -1 with ValueError mentioning maxsplit in all four functions. Preserve -1, zero, and positive behavior. Add tests to tests/test_more.py and run the four split test classes.
cases.agent_test_keyword: SplitAtTests or SplitBeforeTest or SplitAfterTest or SplitWhenTests
